top_signals.title: Bitcoin hovers near $74K as stocks rise despite US bond yield rebound
top_signals.summary: Bitcoin traded in a narrow range as investors bought the dip in tech stocks and US bond yields climbed on high CPI inflation data.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: China Books French, Argentine Wheat as Global Prices Slump
top_signals.summary: At least two cargoes of French wheat and one from Argentina were booked for China last week, according to people familiar with the matter, signaling that a major buyer is snapping up the grain after a slump in global prices.

top_signals.title: Vanguard Says Tax-Loss Inflows to Muni ETFs Likely to Stick
top_signals.summary: Tax-loss harvesting has turbocharged the growth of municipal-bond exchange traded funds in 2026 at the expense of open-end mutual funds, which may lose much of those assets for good, according to Vanguard Group.
